subject: Order #ORD-88231 has not arrived yet
body: Hello, I placed an order (#ORD-88231) over 6 business days ago on November 4th with standard shipping. According to the tracking link, the package has been stuck at the regional distribution center for 3 days with no updates. Could someone please look into this and let me know when I can expect delivery? Thank you!

subject: Requesting a refund for unopened wireless headphones
body: Hi Support Team, I recently received the wireless noise-canceling headphones (Order #ORD-90412) on November 2nd. I ended up receiving another pair as a birthday gift, so these are completely brand new, unopened in their original sealed box. I would like to return them for a full refund back to my credit card. Could you send me the return label and instructions? Thanks.

subject: Error 500 when clicking 'Place Order' on checkout page
body: Whenever I try to complete my purchase on the checkout page, clicking the 'Place Order' button shows an alert: 'Internal Server Error (Code: 500)'. The network tab shows a failed POST request to `/api/v1/checkout/process`. I have tried clearing my Chrome cache and even tried in an Incognito window, but the payment will not go through and my cart remains stuck. I'm using Chrome 124 on Windows 11.
